questions.enonce_markdown:
(i) A random variable, $X$, has probability mass function $p(x)$ given by

$$p(x)=\begin{cases}k(5-x), & \text{for } x=0,1,2,3,4,5\\ 0, & \text{elsewhere}\end{cases}$$

where $k$ is a constant.

(a) Copy and complete the distribution table. *[2 marks]*

| $x$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $P(X=x)$ | | $4k$ | | | $k$ |
questions.corrige_markdown:
Substitute each value of $x$ into $p(x)=k(5-x)$:

- $x=0$: $k(5-0)=5k$
- $x=2$: $k(5-2)=3k$
- $x=3$: $k(5-3)=2k$

| $x$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $P(X=x)$ | $\mathbf{5k}$ | $4k$ | $\mathbf{3k}$ | $\mathbf{2k}$ | $k$ |

(For $x=5$, $p(5)=k(5-5)=0$, so this value has probability $0$ and does not appear in the table.)

The probabilities of a probability mass function add up to $1$:

$$5k+4k+3k+2k+k=1\ \Rightarrow\ 15k=1\ \Rightarrow\ k=\frac1{15}.$$

The distribution is then $P(X=0)=\frac13$, $P(X=1)=\frac4{15}$, $P(X=2)=\frac15$, $P(X=3)=\frac2{15}$, $P(X=4)=\frac1{15}$.

**$k=\dfrac1{15}$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (i)(c) Find the mean and variance of $X$. *[5 marks]*

(ii) In a basket of mangoes, $2$ out of every $5$ mangoes are rotten. Four mangoes are chosen at random from the basket. Using binomial distribution or otherwise, find the probability that

(a) exactly one mango is rotten. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Let $X$ be the number of rotten mangoes among the $4$ chosen. Each mango is rotten with probability $p=\dfrac25=0.4$ (and good with probability $q=0.6$), independently, so $X\sim B(4,\,0.4)$ and

$$P(X=r)=\binom4r(0.4)^r(0.6)^{4-r}.$$

$$P(X=1)=\binom41(0.4)(0.6)^3=4\times0.4\times0.216=0.3456.$$

**The probability that exactly one mango is rotten is $0.3456$** ($=\frac{216}{625}$).

questions.enonce_markdown: (ii)(b) exactly one or two mangoes are rotten. *[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
With $X\sim B(4,0.4)$ ("exactly one or two" means $X=1$ or $X=2$; these are exclusive events, so add):

$$P(X=2)=\binom42(0.4)^2(0.6)^2=6\times0.16\times0.36=0.3456.$$

$$P(X=1\text{ or }2)=P(X=1)+P(X=2)=0.3456+0.3456=0.6912.$$

**The probability is $0.6912$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (ii)(c) Find the mean and variance of $X$ (the number of rotten mangoes in the four chosen). *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
For a binomial distribution $B(n,p)$: mean $=np$ and variance $=npq$. With $n=4$, $p=0.4$, $q=0.6$:

$$E(X)=np=4\times0.4=1.6,\qquad \text{Var}(X)=npq=4\times0.4\times0.6=0.96.$$

**Mean $=1.6$ and variance $=0.96$.**
